hero.eyebrow: A DFW nonprofit built on one repeated act of care
hero.title: Everyone deserves a place to call home.
hero.lead: Pass by Ira works to eradicate homelessness by increasing access to shelter, food, water, healthcare, education, and a livable income across Dallas–Fort Worth.
hero.imageAlt: Aerial view of the Dallas skyline and surrounding neighborhoods

mission.title: Meet urgent needs. Build lasting change.
mission.body: Homelessness is immediate and systemic. Our work brings direct care, public education, and advocacy together so neighbors are seen, supported, and connected to opportunity.
mission.quote: No one should be unseen, underserved, or without a place to call home.

currentNeed.title: Simple essentials can change a day.
currentNeed.body: In-kind donations help our outreach teams respond quickly and with dignity. New, clean, travel-friendly items are easiest to distribute in the field.
currentNeed.imageAlt: Pass by Ira volunteers and community members gathered during outreach

programsIntro.title: Three connected paths to impact.
programsIntro.body: Seasonal outreach meets people where they are. Education shifts understanding. Advocacy helps change the conditions that keep people without stable housing.

story.title: One bottle of water became a daily promise.
story.body: The organization began when founder Jene’a met Ira asking for water on the way to work. Water became snacks, then breakfast, then a consistent relationship—proof that meaningful change can begin with one ordinary act, repeated with intention.
story.imageAlt: Pass by Ira volunteer connecting with a community member during outreach

eventsIntro.title: Recent work and signature gatherings.
eventsIntro.body: See how volunteers, partners, and neighbors turn care into visible action across DFW.

finalCta.title: Give time, give resources, or help carry the story forward.
finalCta.body: Every donation, volunteer hour, and shared message helps Pass by Ira meet immediate needs while building toward long-term change.
